svg.title: The outcome of every task, for each model and harness
svg.desc: A grid with one row per model and harness and one column per task of the 99-task suite, grouped by family. A filled square is a pass, a rose square is a fail, and a blank column is a task outside the 30-task subset of that row. Claude Haiku 5.5 passed 99 of 99 with the plain loop and 99 of 99 as a deep agent. Qwen3 4B passed 70 plain and 55 deep, and Qwen3 8B 74 and 58. On the Qwen3 models the plain loop, create_agent and the hand-built StateGraph rows are the same on every task they share.
svg.text: pass, in the colour of the harness layer
fail: wrong state, wrong tool, or no answer
Rows with 30 tasks ran the stratified subset, six tasks of each family. Blank columns did not run.
Qwen3 rows: greedy decoding on the Mac. Claude rows: the API, default sampling, one run per task.
